responsibility: Implements the token-stream lexer adapter used when reparsing token streams produced for Rust procedural macro expansion. This file provides ProcMacroInvocLexer operations for peeking arbitrary tokens with EOF synthesis and for rewriting the current token entry by splitting combined punctuation or substituting token vectors, which supports parser recovery and correct handling of nested generic closers in proc-macro-produced token streams.
same_name_distinction: Implements the proc-macro token-stream lexer adapter’s behavior, especially lookahead with synthetic EOF and in-place token splitting/replacement for reparsing output token streams. Unlike the paired header, this .cc contains the lexer-manipulation logic rather than the ProcMacroInvocLexer class declaration.
